summary: Notion is an AI workspace platform that helps teams streamline their workflow and automate repetitive tasks. It offers a range of features, including Custom Agents, AI Meeting Notes, and Enterprise Search, to help teams work more efficiently. Notion is trusted by over 100 million users worldwide, including 62% of Fortune 100 companies and over 50% of YC companies. The company is based in San Francisco and has offices around the world.
businessModel: Notion generates revenue through its pricing plans, which include Free, Plus, Business, and Enterprise options. The company also offers Custom Agents and AI Meeting Notes as part of its Business and Enterprise plans. Notion's business model is designed to support everyone from free personal accounts to enterprise businesses.

products.name: Custom Agents
products.description: Custom Agents are AI-powered tools that automate recurring work for teams. They can be set up to perform tasks such as answering questions, routing incoming work, and gathering updates.

products.name: AI Meeting Notes
products.description: AI Meeting Notes is a feature that uses AI to capture and summarize meeting notes. It can also be used to assign tasks and update projects automatically.

painPoints.topic: Streamlining workflow and automating repetitive tasks
painPoints.explanation: Many teams struggle with streamlining their workflow and automating repetitive tasks. Notion's AI-powered features, such as Custom Agents and AI Meeting Notes, are designed to help teams overcome this challenge.
